-- Fungsi Pembuat Tombol
local function CreateButton(name, callback)
	local Btn = Instance.new("TextButton", ScrollFrame)
	Btn.Name = name .. "_Btn"
	Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 12)
	Btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	Btn.Text = string.upper(name)
	Btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230)
	Btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	Btn.TextSize = 14
	Btn.ZIndex = 4
	
	local BtnStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", Btn)
	BtnStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 75, 180)
	BtnStroke.Thickness = 1.5
	
	Btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 25, 35)
		BtnStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 255)
	end)
	Btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 12)
		BtnStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 75, 180)
	end)
	
	Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
end

-- FUNGSI MANAGEMEN MUSIK (Looping & Anti-Bertumpuk)
local function PlayHubMusic(soundId)
	local oldSound = Workspace:FindFirstChild("ISIS_Global_Music")
	if oldSound then
		oldSound:Stop()
		oldSound:Destroy()
	end
	
	local s = Instance.new("Sound")
	s.Name = "ISIS_Global_Music"
	s.SoundId = soundId
	s.Volume = 1
	s.PlaybackSpeed = 1.1
	s.Looped = true
	s.Archivable = false
	s.Parent = Workspace
	task.wait(0.1)
	s:Play()
end

-- Fungsi Pembantu untuk Membersihkan Skybox Lama
local function ClearOldSkybox()
	for _, v in pairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("Sky") then
			v:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

-- 4. Tombol Disco Fog
CreateButton("Disco Fog", function()
	for _, child in pairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Atmosphere") or child:IsA("Clouds") then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end
	
	task.spawn(function()
		local counter = 0
		while true do
			counter = counter + 0.05 
			local r = (math.sin(counter) * 127 + 128) / 255
			local g = (math.sin(counter + 2) * 127 + 128) / 255
			local b = (math.sin(counter + 4) * 127 + 128) / 255
			local rgbColor = Color3.new(r, g, b)
			
			Lighting.Ambient = rgbColor
			Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = rgbColor
			Lighting.FogColor = rgbColor
			Lighting.FogEnd = 150
			task.wait(0.01)
		end
	end)
end)

-- 13. Tombol Raining Nun
CreateButton("Raining Nun", function()
	local isRaining = true
	local RAIN_HEIGHT = 180 
	local SPAWN_RADIUS = 250 
	local SPAWN_DELAY = 0.06 

	local faces = Enum.NormalId:GetEnumItems()

	local function spawnRainBlock(spawnPosition)
		local part = Instance.new("Part")
		part.Size = Vector3.new(20, 20, 20) 
		part.Position = spawnPosition + Vector3.new(
			math.random(-SPAWN_RADIUS, SPAWN_RADIUS),
			RAIN_HEIGHT,
			math.random(-SPAWN_RADIUS, SPAWN_RADIUS)
		)
		
		part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Block
		
		for _, face in ipairs(faces) do
			local decal = Instance.new("Decal")
			decal.Texture = "rbxassetid://10668343207" 
			decal.Face = face
			decal.Parent = part
		end
		
		part.Anchored = false
		part.CanCollide = true
		part.Velocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-15, 15), -70, math.random(-15, 15)) 
		part.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-6, 6), math.random(-6, 6), math.random(-6, 6)) 
		
		part.Parent = Workspace
		game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(part, 5)
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		while isRaining do
			local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
			if localPlayer and localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
				local centerPos = localPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
				for i = 1, 2 do
					spawnRainBlock(centerPos)
				end
			end
			task.wait(SPAWN_DELAY)
		end
	end)
end)

-- Sinkronisasi Fungsi Tombol CLOSE di Header & Tombol OPEN Utama
local function ToggleUI()
	if not MainFrame.Visible then
		MainFrame.Visible = true
		OpenBtn.Text = "CLOSE"
	else
		MainFrame.Visible = false
		OpenBtn.Text = "OPEN"
	end
end

OpenBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(ToggleUI)
CloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	MainFrame.Visible = false
	OpenBtn.Text = "OPEN"
end)
